text:
```yaml
name: Stale Issues and PRs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Runs daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch: # Allows manual triggering

permissions:
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '16'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Run stale action
      run: npx @actions/stale --days=30 --label="stale" --message="This issue has been open for over 30 days without activity. If it's still relevant, please comment below or reopen it."
```
